data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words ana (up) and histemi (to set), Anastatius means 'one who is resurrected' or 'one who is brought back to life'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes new beginnings and hope for a better future. The name Anastatius carries the meaning “Resurrection, Rebirth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anastatius usually hope their child will grow to embody resurrection, rebirth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anastatius carries a rich cultural history, rooted in the Greek language and the Christian tradition. Historically, it was a popular name in the early Christian Church during the Byzantine Empire. Saints Anastasius of Persia, Anastasius I, and Anastasius II were important Christian figures with this name. In some instances, it was also used as a its own name or a titles for other saints, such as St. Anastasius of Sinai.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Anastatius is deeply rooted in the Christian belief in the resurrection of the dead. For those named Anastatius, the name carries a reminder of the promise of new life, healing, and the hope for a better future. The name also echoes the Biblical account of the resurrection of Jesus Christ, a central tenet of Christianity. Therefore, the name Anastatius is a powerful reminder of the transformative power of God to bring new life and restore that which was once lost.
